units: Ber. 11ᵇ וכן הוא אומר and so we read; a. v. fr.—אם כן, אלא אם כן, v. אִם.—לָכֵן for such a purpose.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:1:11">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דרכו ל׳</he> it is usually employed for such a purpose.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:6">Y. Erub. VII, beg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>ייחדו ל׳</he> he devoted it to such &c.—<he>יתר על כן</he>, <he>יתר מִכֵּן</he>, v. <cite ref="J00749"><he>יֶתֶר</he> I</cite>.
